seoTitle: Survey Margin of Error Calculator with Confidence Range
metaDescription: Compute the margin of error and confidence range for a survey result from sample size, result and confidence level. Free and private.
intro: Enter sample size, your result and confidence level to see the plus or minus range.
why:
A result of 56% from 400 people is not exactly 56%: at 95% confidence it is about 51% to 61%. The margin shows how far a result could be from the true value due to sampling alone.

It uses the normal approximation and an optional finite population correction. It is rough near 0% or 100% and for small samples, and does not cover bias or poor wording.
howTo: Enter the result percentage and confidence level.
Add the population if it is small.
Read the margin and the range.

faq.a: The margin when the result is 50%.
